title: Should I take this breakout trade?
caption: A breakout earns a position only when volume confirms the move and the stop still leaves room for a 1.5R+ target. Every other path is a stand-aside.

root.label: Price closed beyond the level
root.detail: Resistance or support broken on the entry timeframe

node.label: Does the stop fit a 1.5R+ target?
node.detail: Risk to the last swing vs. the next structure

node.label: Enter on the retest
node.detail: Risk 1% of equity, stop below the broken level, scale out at 1.5R and 3R.

node.label: Wait for a pullback
node.detail: Reward is too thin. Drop a timeframe and look for a better-priced entry.

node.label: Stand aside, likely a fakeout
node.detail: A breakout on weak volume usually traps. No position; set an alert for a re-test on rising volume.
